capabilities.name: Optional decision models and shadow classification
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Add one useful, merchant-tailored return-intake classification path beside the existing generative runner. Record proposed classifications against authorized case evidence without changing routing, eligibility, money, inventory, approvals, or settlement. The first five goals must work with the current diagnostic fixtures; connected inference remains separately qualified.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Calibrated routing and backend replacement
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Qualify one actually measured decision backend for a bounded routing task, retain review and manual operation, and add a separately evidenced backend-replacement path. Scoped routing does not require GPU or self-hosting expenditure; a portability claim additionally requires two actually exercised implementations.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Sender-bound remote agent access
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Add one standards-based remote authorization profile to the existing task and worker boundaries, so possession of a copied token alone cannot read case data or prepare a proposal. Keep tenant, customer, task, policy, approval, lease and stop decisions in the existing server authority.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Managed execution security
capabilities.proposed_priority: P0 before claiming managed egress or protected-data graph enforcement
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Qualify one operator-managed runner boundary with mediated network access, constrained resources and a bounded two-branch restriction demonstration, while stating the narrower guarantees available for external agents. Keep AI Gateway use optional.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Multimodal evidence assistance
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Introduce an explicitly opt-in image-first evidence-assistance path only after qualifying intake, authorized model access, and the full privacy lifecycle. Keep audio/video disabled unless a named additional use case and its media pipeline are separately declared and qualified.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Persistent commerce journeys
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Continue a verified shopper's supported commerce journey across visits, channels and agent runtimes, using durable source-backed context and the existing action gateway.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Warehouse routes, waves and supplies

capabilities.name: Individualized campaign production

capabilities.scope_note: Adopted Rifare target under ADR-0042. Separate work records hold actual local progress; formal qualification is not inferred.

capabilities.name: Browser Clef-flash with pinned Kevala Q8 text
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Add optional on-device text decision assistance using the complete Clef-flash joint model in a pinned Kevala WebGPU runtime. Browser suggestions are untrusted client observations and remain shadow-only; no inference or product qualification is supplied by this plan.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted browser target under ADR-0044. No browser implementation or qualification is claimed; actual assignment and progress belong to work records.

capabilities.name: Compact browser backend with joint-path verification
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Add an optional compact Clef-flash Q4 browser implementation after verifying or repairing Wllama's complete joint decision route, and compare it with Kevala using predeclared paired evidence. Preserve the separate M14 server transport and all server-owned business authority.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted browser target under ADR-0044. No browser implementation or qualification is claimed; actual assignment and progress belong to work records.

capabilities.name: Browser image evidence with a qualified vision decision path
capabilities.proposed_functionality: Add optional image-first browser evidence assistance after M17's media intake and privacy foundations, using a matched vision companion and a proven image-aware joint decision API. Preserve untrusted client provenance and server-owned business authority.
capabilities.scope_note: Adopted browser target under ADR-0044. No browser implementation or qualification is claimed; actual assignment and progress belong to work records.
